long_biography.plain_text:
Schön took over active leadership of his family's clinic business eleven years after his parents opened its first site. He built around medical specialisation, adding hospitals and treatment centres across Germany while retaining family ownership. More than three decades at the top ended when he withdrew from day-to-day management; he remains chairman of the group's governing board.

Competitive sailing has been a long-running part of Schön's public life. He won the Dragon World Championship, later claimed consecutive Maxi 72 world titles, and swept the Six Metre world and European championships in one season. A new campaign brought him another Six Metre world title in 2025.
